text:
Your cheap shoes aren't stopping you. Your cheaper belief is.

Edison hired a tramp named Barnes. No degree. No credentials.

One thing Barnes had: absolute certainty he could do the work.

Edison saw that belief in his eyes, not the outfit.

People sense what you believe about yourself before they see what you wear.

Every door you didn't walk through? You didn't believe you belonged.

Stop waiting for the right look. You already have what it takes.

You thought polish would open doors. Certainty actually does.
caption:
Your mindset beats appearance. Self improvement is real when you build belief in yourself. That's the foundation for every success.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#mindset #selfdevelopment #belief #conviction #success
